company.shortDescription: Because is personal care direct-to-consumer company focused on meeting the needs of older adults.
company.description: Because is a high growth, direct-to-consumer personal care company focused on older adults. We started in 2017 with a simple idea - to make it easier for our families to get the products they needed. Today, we are on our way to becoming the #1 trusted brand for older adults, with the goal of helping millions lead vibrant, independent lives. We’ve raised over $40M in funding from top VC firms including Index Ventures and Khosla Ventures, and are grateful for the support for our customers, partners and investors.

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series B round raised $35,000,000, or 53.85% of reported total funding.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $131,707,357 to $213,700,269, a 1.62x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
